title: Tangy Teriyaki Beef and Pork Meatballs with Buttery Rice and Wholesome Veggies
description: This recipe combines savoury teriyaki beef and pork meatballs with fresh green vegetables and buttery rice. The meatballs are glazed in a honey-garlic teriyaki sauce and served alongside tender-crisp snap peas and zucchini.

items.name: zucchini
items.notes: halved lengthwise and cut into 1/4-inch half-moons

steps.instruction: To a medium pot, add 1 1/4 cups water and 1/8 tsp salt. Cover and bring to a boil over high heat. Meanwhile, rinse rice in a strainer until water runs clear. Add rice to the boiling water, then reduce heat to low. Cover and cook until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed. Remove from heat and set aside, still covered.

Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. To a large bowl, add ground beef and pork, panko, half the green onions, and half the garlic salt. Season with pepper and combine. Roll mixture into 8 equal-sized meatballs and place on the prepared baking sheet. Roast meatballs in the middle of the oven until golden and cooked through.
To a medium bowl, add honey-garlic sauce, soy sauce, vinegar, half the cornstarch, and 1/4 cup water. Season with salt and pepper. Whisk until evenly combined and set aside.

Heat a large non-stick pan over medium-high. When hot, add 1/2 tbsp oil, snap peas, and zucchini. Season with remaining garlic salt and pepper. Cook, stirring often, until tender-crisp. Transfer veggies to a plate and cover to keep warm.

Once meatballs are cooked, reheat the same pan over medium. When hot, add half the garlic spread and swirl pan until melted. Add teriyaki sauce mixture (whisk again if separated). Cook, stirring often, until sauce is warmed through and thickened slightly. Remove from heat. Add meatballs and stir to coat.

Fluff rice with a fork. Stir in remaining green onions and remaining garlic spread. Divide rice between plates. Top with veggies and meatballs. Spoon any remaining teriyaki sauce from the pan over top.
